frontmatter.name: codebase-engineering
frontmatter.description: Default working method for the Moti PWA (React 19 + Vite + shadcn aria-vega + React Query + zustand + Supabase) — understand before changing, copy the nearest existing slice, plan and wait for approval, make the smallest correct change, validate with yarn build + yarn lint, hand over a commit suggestion. Use for any feature, bug fix, or refactor request in this repo.

Use before any service file, table, column, migration, policy, RPC, storage bucket or auth change.
